last_known_message: Run failed during baseline evaluation after generating 3/10 baseline responses. No fine_tune_job_id or model_id was created.
failure_notes: Base Qwen 4B endpoint reached InService at 2026-06-02T17:45:15Z.
Baseline evaluation started with validation split capped at 10 examples.
Eval worker generated 3/10 baseline responses, then the ECS eval-worker container exited with code 1.
CloudWatch eval-worker logs show SageMaker returned a 424 CLIENT_ERROR_FROM_MODEL.
SageMaker endpoint logs show vLLM rejected an eval prompt because serving max context was 8192 tokens: 7937 input tokens + 256 output tokens = 8193.
The practical fix is to upload a capped/chunked dataset whose eval and train rows stay comfortably below the 8192-token serving limit.
